fields.v: HSE (no version), 10 skills (8 procedural, 2 recovery) evolved on SWE-Gym. Baselines: No Skills; SWESkillsBench (49 domain skills); GEPA (prompt evolution); ReasoningBank

Skill library of SKILL.md documents (frontmatter with support counts, quality score, use policy; sections Applicability, Evidence Gate, Actions, Do Not, Support Summary); candidate representation (trigger, evidence gate, actions, validation, stop condition); external writer rules and evaluator weights; L1 task evidence records tagged reproduce/locate/edit/validate/recover. No specification of the software

Training: frozen agent produces trajectories -> L1 task evidence with outcome-transition labels -> L2 repository-conditioned candidates (writer proposes, evaluator accepts/revises/rejects) -> L3 cross-repository procedural and recovery skills -> held-out validation (promote or retain previous state) -> writer/evaluator rule updates -> next round. Inference: frozen skill library injected into agent. Optional target-benchmark adaptation (8 rounds, no verifier feedback)

fields.v: Tasks: SWE-bench Verified (500) and DeepSWE (113), complete sets; skills evolved on disjoint SWE-Gym repositories. Configurations: 5 methods x 2 harnesses x 2 benchmarks with GLM-5.2; ablations; cross-harness and cross-model (GPT-5.5, Opus 4.8 with Pi). Baseline: No Skills. Held constant: model and harness within comparison, benchmark verifier. Acceptance tests: benchmark verifier. Repetitions: 3 runs (Mean@3, sample SD); per-run counts in Tables 13-14; ablation and cross-model tables single values. Human intervention: none

HSE best mean in all four settings: +1.9 to +4.5 points over No Skills on Verified, +5.6 to +7.7 on DeepSWE; +0.7 to +0.9 over SWESkillsBench on Verified, +2.1 to +3.5 over GEPA on DeepSWE. SWESkillsBench degrades DeepSWE. HSE uses 34%/39% fewer words than SWESkillsBench with Pi, 6%/3% with CC, but more than No Skills. No significance tests

Distinguished methods on means with small SDs on Verified; differences on Verified are under 1 point vs the best baseline and untested statistically. Adaptation is evaluated on the same tasks whose trajectories update the library (no verifier feedback, but same task set). Limitations stated: cross-model only under Pi; controller ablation evaluates update mechanism as a whole
Two benchmarks, two harnesses, three models; cross-model evaluation only under Pi; controller ablation evaluates the writer-evaluator update mechanism as a whole. Gap not stated further
